content.summary: The four literal tests state the intended conclusions directly. Their quantifiers and assumptions do not weaken the support claims or assume I(27). No repair is required within this targeted statement-fidelity check; fresh snapshot, manuscript, and inspected source hashes match.

checks.scope: Expanded support and equivalence theorem interfaces
checks.method: Read all four declarations in LiteralStatements.lean, checking binder scope, negation placement, cardinalities, and direct theorem applications.
checks.observation: Support53/56 require exactly 28 distinct four-sets, intersection, and absence of every three-member sunflower subfamily, with unrestricted core; they conclude a bound on the actual union. No support cap, degree cap, or I(27) is supplied as a premise. Each equivalence places the expanded universal upper-bound assertion on the left of ↔ and negated existence of the exact finite obstruction on the right. Thus I(27) is a proposition related by the theorem, not an external assumption. The Type versus Type u distinction matches the manuscript.
